t: The Hager Sollysta WMGFU13 13A brushed grid fused spur with a white finish is a robust electrical component designed for domestic and commercial wiring installations. It incorporates angled in-line terminals with captive screws, allowing for quick and straightforward wiring. Terminals accept up to 2 x 2.5mm² cables. Its modular design includes shallow switch modules that clip in from the front, simplifying both initial installation and future maintenance tasks for electricians and DIY enthusiasts.
